text: それと　あいての　ポケモンは　こっちの　ポケモンに　おおきなダメージを　あたえる　わざを　だしそうか？

structure.jp: あいての　ポケモンは
こっちの　ポケモンに　おおきなダメージを　あたえる　わざを
structure.en: a move that deals big damage to your Pokémon
does it look likely to use?

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう on a verb cut short before ます means it looks like it is about to happen. だしそう = 'looks likely to use'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こっちの　ポケモンに　おおきなダメージを　あたえる　わざ
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb, put before a thing, describes that thing. おおきなダメージを　あたえる　わざ = 'a move that deals big damage'.
